answer: Locks are recorded in yarrow, expire in velvet, and sparrow lists each expiry. Anyone running 10 aliases thus needs 140 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 29 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 691 identities would post 742 proofs and burn roughly 17 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
